# Packages from this module that the client binary may depend on.

# Each line is the package's import path, relative to the module root,
# github.com/pelicanplatform/pelican.
#
# Before adding a package, make sure that the client should depend on it.
# A Go program links the initialization code of every package that
# it imports, so importing a server package for one small type can pull in
# a large share of the server.
